questions.q: Solve the simultaneous system $y - 2x = 3$ and $x^2 + y^2 = 26$ for the positive solution pair $(x, y)$.
Find the two points of intersection of the line $2x + y = 7$ and the rectangular hyperbola $xy = 6$.
Determine the value of $k$ for which the line $x + y = k$ is tangent to the curve $y = \frac{4}{x}$.

sections.heading: Section 2: Quadratic Inequalities in One Variable

questions.q: Find the set of values of $x$ satisfying the quadratic inequality $2x^2 - 5x - 3 \geq 0$.
Find the range of values of $x$ for which the expression $9 - x^2$ is strictly positive.

sections.heading: Section 3: Rational Inequalities and Sign Analysis

questions.answer: Sign changes at $x = -3$ and $x = 2$. Denominator cannot be 0, so $x \in (-3, 2]$.

questions.q: Find the complete solution set for the inequality $\frac{2x + 1}{x - 1} > 1$.
Solve the inequality $\frac{1}{x} < 2$ for all non-zero real $x$.

sections.heading: Section 4: Systems with Modulus and Geometric Applications

questions.q: Find the values of $x$ satisfying the simultaneous conditions $|x - 3| \leq 4$ and $x^2 - 4x > 0$.
The perimeter of a right-angled triangle is $30 \text{ cm}$ and its hypotenuse is $13 \text{ cm}$. Find the lengths of the two legs.
Find the range of values of $x$ where the line $y = 3x - 2$ lies entirely above the parabola $y = x^2 - 2x + 4$.
